# Health

A private dashboard for your own lab results and nutrition plan, at
health.openhouse.ink. Most of the site is behind sign-in and holds personal
health records; there is nothing here to crawl.

If you are an AI connected to this account's MCP server, read the standing
brief before interpreting anything:

- [MCP guidelines](https://health.openhouse.ink/mcp-guidelines.md): the rules
  (R1–R10), how the data is shaped, and what the server does not contain.
- [What it is](https://health.openhouse.ink/learnmore): the public description.
- [Connect your AI](https://health.openhouse.ink/chatgpt): setup steps for
  ChatGPT and Claude. Behind sign-in.
